title: Determine Whether One Tree is a Subtree of Another
problemStatement: Given the roots of two binary trees, determine whether the second tree is a subtree of the first tree. A subtree consists of a node and all of its descendants.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first tree. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second tree.
output: • Print YES if the second tree is a subtree of the first; otherwise print NO.
